title: A tour of the screen
goal: Find the symbol search, the watchlist and the toolbar.

objectives.text: Find the drawing tools on the left.
Know the chart fills the middle.

slides.text: The screen has four parts. They are the top, the left, the middle and the right.
slides.title: Four parts

slides.text: At the top left is the symbol search. Type a ticker like AAPL and press Enter. The chart shows that stock.
slides.title: The symbol search

slides.text: The toolbar is a strip of icons on the left. It holds the drawing tools. You will use them soon.
slides.title: The toolbar

slides.text: The big middle part is the chart. Prices run up the right edge. Time is at the bottom.
slides.title: The big middle

slides.text: A watchlist is a list of tickers to watch. It sits on the right. Tap a ticker to open its chart.
slides.title: The watchlist

slides.text: The top has a few buttons. They change what you see. You will meet each one soon.
slides.title: The top buttons

questions.prompt: Where do you type a ticker like AAPL?
questions.explanation: The symbol search is at the top left. Type a ticker there.

questions.prompt: A watchlist is a list of tickers to watch.
questions.explanation: Yes. Tap a ticker in the watchlist to open its chart.

options.text: In the toolbar on the left

questions.explanation: The toolbar on the left holds the drawing tools.

questions.prompt: What fills the big middle part?
questions.explanation: The chart sits in the middle. Tools and lists sit around it.

questions.prompt: Match each part to its job.

pairs.definition: A list of tickers to watch

questions.explanation: The search finds a ticker. The watchlist keeps tickers. The toolbar holds tools.
The watchlist sits on the right side.

questions.prompt: The toolbar is where you find the drawing tools.
questions.explanation: Yes. The toolbar holds all of the drawing tools.
